name: Fight Bite / Human Bite Injury of the Hand
tags: fight bite / human bite injury of the hand
definition: Human-bite injury, especially clenched-fist laceration over an MCP joint, with high risk of joint, tendon and deep-space infection.

core: Inspect wound through full finger motion

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess foreign body/tooth fragment or fracture; cultures are obtained when infection/debridement is present.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Do not close high-risk contaminated fight-bite wounds casually.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vrana/Shotha concepts are secondary to modern wound and infection management.

patientEducation.summary: Human-bite injury, especially clenched-fist laceration over an MCP joint, with high risk of joint, tendon and deep-space infection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
